content.title: THE {{FIX}} FOR THINGS THAT ANNOY YOU EVERY WEEK
facts: **Bloating** – Fennel seeds, 1 tsp chewed after meals, relax the gut muscles and let trapped gas move through faster.
**Bad Breath** – A slice of apple or a stick of celery scrubs odor-causing bacteria off the tongue when you can't brush.
**Leg Cramps** – 1 cup coconut water replaces the potassium and electrolytes your muscles need to stop seizing up.
**Brain Fog** – A square of dark chocolate (70%+) gives a slow caffeine-like lift without the crash of coffee.
**Dry, Cracked Lips** – Sunflower seeds, a small handful a day, supply zinc that speeds up skin barrier repair.
**Restless Legs at Night** – A banana before bed brings potassium and magnesium together to calm nerve signals.
**Puffy Under-Eyes** – Cucumber slices or just eating cucumber adds water and reduces the sodium bloat that causes puffiness.
**Constant Yawning at Your Desk** – A handful of walnuts mid-afternoon steadies blood sugar so your brain stops signaling low energy.
**Follow along** – for more daily health tips like this.

caption:
Fennel seeds are one of the easiest fixes on this list because they actually work on contact — chewing them releases anethole, a compound that relaxes the smooth muscle lining your intestines, which is why bloating eases within minutes instead of hours. Coconut water gets overlooked for cramps because people reach for plain water first, but plain water can't replace the potassium and sodium your muscles lose through sweat or just a long day on your feet — that's the actual reason the cramp keeps coming back. And walnuts work on afternoon yawning because their fat and fiber combo slows down digestion, which prevents the blood sugar dip that makes your brain think it needs sleep. Everyone's body reacts a little differently, so pay attention to what actually helps yours.
